summary: Iteration 3 full-stack testing complete for Reel Videos, Artist Categories Filter, Testimonial Uploads, and Homepage Ordering. Backend: 36/36 pytest tests pass (10 iteration-1 regressions + 15 iteration-2 + 11 new iteration-3). New tests cover: public GET /api/testimonials (5 seeded), auth protection on POST/DELETE /api/admin/testimonials and PATCH /api/admin/media, testimonial create/get/delete + soft-delete removes from public list + 404 on second delete, /api/media sorted asc by sort_order, PATCH /api/admin/media sort_order swap persistence, PATCH title/is_reel updates, PATCH nonexistent -> 404, video mp4 upload returns kind='video' and appears in /api/media?reel=true, /api/files serves testimonial storage_path (200 while active, 404 after soft-delete). Frontend: (a) /artists Star Roster shows [artist-filter-all] + 6 category tabs (bollywood/bhangra/russian-international/dj/live-band/mascot); All shows 6, clicking Bollywood filters to 1, back to All restores 6. (b) /testimonials page renders all 5 seeded names (Ananya, Karan, Priya, Sahil, Vikram). (c) Admin Testimonials tab: added a testimonial via name/role/rating(4-star)/text -> list grew 5->6, unique name visible, delete button removes it -> back to 5. (d) Admin Media Gallery reorder buttons EXIST but are BLOCKED for real user clicks by the category badge span rendered on top (see critical UI bug below); backend PATCH + move() handler logic verified working when invoked via DOM .click() (swap of first two items succeeded and API reflected the new sort_order, then restored). (e) Home page shows 6 instagram-reel cards (seeded reels are images; no video items seeded so autoplay attribute could not be visually verified live, but InstagramFeed.jsx source has autoPlay muted loop playsInline on the <video> element - confirmed via code review).

ui_bugs.issue: Category badge <span> at absolute top-2 left-2 (line 139-142 of AdminMedia.jsx) is rendered AFTER the hover overlay in DOM order and therefore sits on top of the media-up/media-down buttons, intercepting pointer events. Playwright confirms 'subtree intercepts pointer events' error on real click. Even force=True click fails to reorder. Backend PATCH and move() handler both work when triggered via el.click() bypassing hit-test. Result: an actual user cannot reorder media by clicking the up/down arrows in the top-left of a card — feature #4 (Homepage Ordering) is effectively broken through the UI. Fix: add `pointer-events-none` to the badge container div, OR give the overlay's action-row a higher z-index (z-20) and `pointer-events-auto`, OR move the badges to bottom-left / opposite corner from the arrows.

action_items: HIGH: Fix AdminMedia.jsx overlay stacking so users can actually click the media-up/media-down arrows. Simplest fix: add `pointer-events-none` to the `<div className='absolute top-2 left-2 flex gap-1'>` at line ~139, since it only shows informational badges.
(Optional) Seed at least one video reel or exercise a real .mp4 upload path in UI QA to visually confirm autoplay on Instagram feed.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminMedia.jsx move() calls Promise.all of two PATCH requests then load(); if only one PATCH succeeds you get an inconsistent order in DB. Consider a single backend endpoint to swap two sort_orders atomically, or verify both responses before load().
AdminMedia.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete; Playwright needs a dialog handler. Consider replacing with a shadcn/ui AlertDialog for consistency and testability.
TestimonialCreate model doesn't validate rating range (0-5). Consider `rating: int = Field(5, ge=1, le=5)`.
server.py put_object/get_object still use sync `requests` inside async endpoints — same feedback as iteration 2; blocks event loop under concurrency.

server.py create_media sets sort_order=max+1 but seed_content assigns sort_order starting at 0. When admin adds new media, it ends up at the END (correct). However create_testimonial always assigns sort_order=0, which will collide with seeded testimonials — consider max+1 for consistency.
seed_content: `is_reel: i < 6` seeds the first 6 media as reels — coupled to seed order, fine but brittle if the seed list changes.
AdminMedia badge div lacks pointer-events-none, hits the arrow buttons (see UI bug).

rca of the issue:
AdminMedia.jsx line 139-142 renders `
category{reel && }
` OUTSIDE and AFTER the group-hover overlay div (line 123-138) that contains the up/down/delete buttons. Both are positioned absolutely at top-left with no z-index / no `pointer-events-none` on the badges. Because the badge div is later in the DOM, its span children win the pointer hit-test at the exact coordinates of the media-up (top-2 left-2) and media-down buttons. Real user clicks fall on the badge and do nothing. Reproduction: (1) login admin, (2) go to Media Gallery, (3) hover any card, (4) attempt to click the up-arrow (or down-arrow) icon in the top-left → nothing happens. Verified via Playwright which reported: `weddings subtree intercepts pointer events`. Mitigation: add `className='absolute top-2 left-2 flex gap-1 pointer-events-none'` to the badge container div; the badges are purely informational and don't need clicks.
